mapper.select: SELECT a.bmt10_info_id AS info_id , a.bmt10_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id , b.ast01_class_tree_nm AS ast_class_tree_name , a.bmt10_apply_date::date AS apply_date , a.bmt10_retire_date::date AS retire_date , a.bmt10_acq_amount AS acq_amount , a.bmt10_acq_info AS acq_info , a.bmt10_spec AS spec , a.bmt10_note AS note , COALESCE(f_emp_kor_nm(( SELECT c.bmt11_person_id FROM bmt11_history c WHERE c.bmt11_info_id = a.bmt10_info_id AND c.bmt11_start_date <= #{baseDate} ORDER BY c.bmt11_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 )), '') AS person_name FROM bmt10_info a INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree b ON b.ast01_class_tree_id = a.bmt10_ast_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.bmt10_info_id = #{infoId} AND a.bmt10_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT a.bmt10_info_id AS info_id , a.bmt10_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id , b.ast01_class_tree_nm AS ast_class_tree_name , a.bmt10_apply_date::date AS apply_date , a.bmt10_retire_date::date AS retire_date , a.bmt10_acq_amount AS acq_amount , a.bmt10_acq_info AS acq_info , a.bmt10_spec AS spec , a.bmt10_note AS note , NULL::varchar AS person_name FROM bmt10_info a INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree b ON b.ast01_class_tree_id = a.bmt10_ast_class_tree_id WHERE a.bmt10_info_id = #{infoId} AND a.bmt10_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bmt10_info ( bmt10_info_id, bmt10_company_id, bmt10_ast_class_tree_id , bmt10_apply_date, bmt10_retire_date, bmt10_acq_amount, bmt10_acq_info, bmt10_spec, bmt10_note ) VALUES ( #{infoId}, #{companyId}, #{req.astClassTreeId} , #{req.applyDate}, #{req.retireDate}, #{req.acqAmount}, #{req.acqInfo}, #{req.spec}, #{req.note} )
